youtube_description:
Liquid Church of NJ, conducted live polling about election politics during the sermon via text messaging. ChurchMag Editor Eric Dye asks Pastor Tim Lucas a few questions about the experience.

You can leave comments at http://churchm.ag/liquid-church-live-polling-interview
